audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names 'Dredge Line' as the Yasuo ability to track — Dredge Line is Nautilus's own Q — and states 'he can't Wind Wall a hook', which is false.
audit.why: Dredge Line and Depth Charge both carry the projectile flag; Wind Wall (W, 25/23/21/19/17s, 4 seconds) blocks all enemy projectiles, so it eats both. The content layer already says this correctly, so the two layers contradicted each other on the single decisive interaction of the lane.
audit.corrected: Track Wind Wall, not 'Dredge Line'. Bait the wall with Riptide or a dummy Q, then commit Q and R into its 25s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 through 6 are credited to Yasuo/Skill though the packet chart and every matching why give them to Nautilus.
audit.why: With W and E up, the pull into passive root pins a Yasuo whose only answer is a Sweeping Blade off a minion; the lane only flips once he has crit items.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 Nautilus; First item Skill; 2+ items Yasuo.

audit.why: Spikes cover level 1 Wind Wall, level 3 full pattern, level 6 Depth Charge and his 2-item crit takeover.

edits.before: Q-hook him — he can’t Wind Wall a hook, chain CC. Nautilus wins the Dredge Line cooldown windows.

edits.before: - Nautilus vs Yasuo - Track: Yasuo Dredge Line. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Dredge Line's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nautilus vs Yasuo - Track: Yasuo Wind Wall. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Wind Wall's cooldown. - Never throw Q or R into the wall. - Ultimate = kill windows only.

edits.after: Bait the wall, then Q-hook

edits.before: - Yasuo Dredge Line: matchup-defining — Hook — Wind Wall can’t block it; pulls you to him. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — 25s at rank 1, and it eats both Dredge Line and Depth Charge. Bait it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Yasuo's Dredge Line: Hook — Wind Wall can’t block it; pulls you to him. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Track Yasuo's Wind Wall: it blocks Dredge Line and Depth Charge for 4s. When it is down — Q-E + R him.

edits.before: Q-hook him — he can’t Wind Wall a hook, chain CC.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats your hook — bait it, then chain CC.

edits.before: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Only take the trade when Yasuo's Dredge Line is down.
edits.after: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Take the trade while Yasuo's Wind Wall is down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dredge Line's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: trade around Wind Wall's 25s and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dredge Line's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Wind Wall's cooldown.

edits.before: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Respect Yasuo's Dredge Line completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Respect Yasuo's Wind Wall completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Dredge Line: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Wind Wall: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.

edits.before: Yasuo: Dredge Line online, level 6, first item. Nautilus: levels 2-3 (full pattern), Iceborn Gauntlet first-item spike, and the 2-item front-line window.
edits.after: Yasuo: Wind Wall online, level 6, first crit item. Nautilus: levels 2-3 (full pattern), Iceborn Gauntlet first-item spike, and the 2-item front-line window.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dredge Line and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you bait Wind Wall and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: If Yasuo gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Dredge Line. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Yasuo gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Wind Wall. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

edits.before: Commit on Dredge Line's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Iceborn Gauntlet timing. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Wind Wall's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Iceborn Gauntlet timing. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: Your CC is premium gank setup — ping your jungler when Dredge Line is down. Ward river before extended trades.
edits.after: Your CC is premium gank setup — ping your jungler when Wind Wall is down. Ward river before extended trades.

edits.before: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Iceborn Gauntlet timing, then freeze and zone Yasuo off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler when Dredge Line is down.
edits.after: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Iceborn Gauntlet timing, then freeze and zone Yasuo off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler when Wind Wall is down.

notes: Two hard errors fixed here. (1) The full layer told the player to track 'Yasuo Dredge Line' — Dredge Line is Nautilus's own Q. (2) It claimed Wind Wall cannot block the hook; both Dredge Line and Depth Charge carry the projectile flag and Wind Wall blocks all enemy projectiles for 4s, which the content layer already stated correctly. Chart rows 1-5 flipped as a paired group. report[12] and report[13] also carry the old 'Dredge Line' phrasing but are duplicates of breakdown.feeding and ahead, which are corrected here.
